title: Creek Bank Erosion
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this service request if there is Erosion occurring on a creek bank, dam or retention wall threatening a property or structure. Erosion is the breakdown of land around you; causing the earth to wear away and dissolve...this is often caused by water, wind or ice. The estimated response time (ERT) for this request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.label: Type of erosion:
options: Roadway ditch/Other public right of way

observedQuestions.label: Are you in a designated floodplain area?
Provide panel #:
observedQuestions.condition: Floodplain = Yes and Do you know your panel # = Yes

observedQuestions.label: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

observedInstructions: For erosion types Alley, Construction site, and Roadway ditch/Other public right of way, a New Service Type Suggestion popup recommended Creek Bank Erosion and displayed its drawer description. If erosion type is Other, the form adds a required description. Floodplain Yes adds Do you know your panel #? Yes adds Provide panel #; No does not. Floodplain No/Unknown adds no panel questions. Type and floodplain options were checked in combination.
detailsForm.contactStepObserved: Contact step displayed optional consent checkbox; First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number, Address, City, State, Zipcode were disabled by default.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about erosion threatening property or a structure.
actions.why: Report erosion at a creek bank, dam, or retaining wall that threatens property or a structure. The 311 request form also asks whether the erosion is at an alley, construction site, roadway ditch, or other public right of way, and whether the location is in a designated floodplain. Erosion can involve land worn away by water, wind, or ice.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Creek Bank Erosion"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Creek Bank Erosion"
